verdict.rationale: Plaid documents a liveness check that confirms a person is present and matches their ID photo (plaid-idv-docs-21), directly supporting the selfie-to-document liveness story, and risk-scoring features around it (plaid-idv-docs-11, plaid-idv-docs-20). However, there is no documentation detailing specific anti-spoofing defenses (printed photos, screen replay, video injection) or any independent test/benchmark validating liveness robustness. Missing for 10: technical detail on spoof-attack defenses, third-party/independent testing of liveness accuracy, and documentation of specific attack vectors covered.
